_comment: Per-record field overrides for items — the escape hatch curated/CLAUDE.md
describes, created for the automation pieces nobody could find by search.
Only two fields may be set here, and the build enforces that:
also_known_as — other names the thing goes by. Search matches on a
contiguous substring of the folded name, so 'Water Sprite Statue' never
answers a search for 'water statue', and nothing in the game contains
the words 'auto petter' at all — that is the community's name for the
Animal Sprite Statue, and the app should answer to it.
blurb — our own factual sentence about what the thing does, per
docs/DATA-POLICY.md: facts in our own words, never the in-game
description and never a paraphrase of it. Every blurb here states only
what the named source states as data.
Every entry carries `reason` and `source`. An id that does not exist in
the built items dataset fails the build — a typo must not silently

water_sprite.blurb: With an essence stone set, waters every crop within 2 tiles each morning. Works on the farm and in greenhouses.
water_sprite.reason: unfindable by the name people search for; the function is the fact a reader wants

water_sprite_large.blurb: With an essence stone set, waters every crop within 3 tiles each morning. Works on the farm and in greenhouses.
water_sprite_large.reason: unfindable by the name people search for; the function is the fact a reader wants

ocarina_sprite_statue.blurb: Placed in a large barn or coop with an essence stone set, it pets every animal housed there each day.
ocarina_sprite_statue.reason: the community calls it an auto petter and nothing in its real name matches that search
ocarina_sprite_statue.source: object_prototypes/furniture.toml [ocarina_sprite_statue]: essence_machine, placeable_locations = large_coop/large_barn; wiki Animal Sprite Statue page states the petting effect

auto_feeder.blurb: Holds a stock of feed and refills the troughs of the coop or barn it stands in each morning, matching the feed's quality.
auto_feeder.reason: shipped with the wiki's 'Missing Data' tag and no statement of what it does
auto_feeder.source: items/other/misc.toml [auto_feeder] stated behaviour; object_prototypes/furniture.toml places it in large_coop/large_barn

seed_maker.blurb: Converts a harvested crop or forageable into one to three of its own seeds.
seed_maker.reason: new in the 1.5.1 sweep with no wiki row to describe it
seed_maker.source: items/other/misc.toml [seed_maker] stated behaviour; sold by the general store (stores.toml)
